purpose: Stage real animation sources independently of character rigging. The runtime bridge consumes normalized AnimationClip artifacts after target skeleton validation.

sources.notes: Existing ingest.cjs, bake_clips.cjs, map_combat_moves.cjs and move_sheet.py.

sources.license: per asset; README records source licenses
sources.notes: Prefer CC0/public-domain sources and sources explicitly permitted for product use.

sources.license: engine BSD-3-Clause; character/stage/music assets are not redistributable per upstream
sources.notes: Use engine code/animation architecture where license permits; do not copy upstream proprietary character assets.
Use fighting-game animation/state-machine architecture and compatible open assets; current upstream targets UE 5.7.
Do not import/repackage proprietary Tekken animation/character data unless a specific asset has documented redistribution rights.

pipeline: convert FBX/BVH/animated GLB to normalized AnimationClip source
retarget source clip to canonical target skeleton
bind bridge artifact to visible cloned GLB
invariants: No synthetic animation is presented as authored animation.
No clip is PASS when track resolution is unknown.
No runtime action is considered active merely because .play() returned.
Character rigging and animation-source ingestion remain separable lanes.
Proprietary or unclear-license animation bytes remain reference-only.
